A '''launching platform''' was a [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] landing platform located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]]. It was owned by the intergalactic [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] group, the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Aquaris Freeholders]]. When a ship is about to land, the launching platform rises out of the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] to allow it to land. Personnel were then transported to the ocean floor to the main [[Freeholders' Base]].<ref name="TG" />

One such platform was used by the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to arrive on Aquaris regarding recruiting the Aquaris Freeholders into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. After the deputy commander, [[Kraaken]], turned traitor, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and Kraaken fought on the deck of the landing platform, the former having become privvy to his treacherous actions due to an encounter with a [[demonsquid]].<ref name="TG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The launching platforms bore large resemblance to real-life Supercarriers.
